function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive, source-bounded investigation of the Guccifer 2.0 and DCLeaks personas and the complete attribution chain connecting—or failing to connect—them to Russian military intelligence and GRU-controlled election-interference operations. Use only evidence you can directly return from benchmark/tool sources, and assign a stable source ID to every source returned (for example, SOURCE-1, SOURCE-2); do not rely on unstated background knowledge. Prioritize primary public evidence: United States public indictments and court filings, official incident-response reports and technical analyses, platform or provider disclosures, and contemporaneous persona communications where available. For each source, give title, issuing organization or author, publication date if available, URL or document identifier if available, and the exact relevant evidence or a precise paraphrase. Cover separately: (1) the claimed or established identities of Guccifer 2.0 and DCLeaks, including what evidence supports identity claims and what remains allegation or analytical assessment; (2) persona activities and released materials; (3) infrastructure, domains, hosting, accounts, malware, metadata, operational security, and other technical indicators; (4) communications, timing, language, or behavioral evidence; (5) operational relationships between the personas, campaign targets, intermediaries, and Russian military-intelligence units; (6) public indictment evidence, distinguishing allegations from adjudicated facts; (7) incident-response evidence and its evidentiary limits; (8) competing narratives or denials and any evidence supporting them; and (9) unresolved contradictions and uncertainty. Build an explicit attribution chain with links only where directly supported by returned evidence. Do not infer or invent facts. Make clear which facts are established, which are allegations, which are analytical assessments, and which are unresolved. The eventual report must cite only your returned source IDs, so ensure every significant assertion is mapped to one or more source IDs. Return a structured evidence dossier suitable for a final Markdown report, including candidate entity IDs and relationship names only where the source directly supports them."}
function.name: ConductResearch
